dateOfBirth.description: SELF entity only. Other entities use age field instead.

age.description: Age in years. SELF entity: system-derived from dateOfBirth. Non-SELF entities (spouse, children, parents): user-input.

gender.description: Biological sex. Used in actuarial contexts.

maritalStatus.description: Legal marital status. Gates SPOUSE entity creation. Affects household income model and HUF tax eligibility.

options.label: Divorced
options.infotip: Alimony paid/received: reflect in expense/income fields.

cityName.description: Current residence city. Source for cityTier derivation.
cityName.infotip: Enter current residence city, not hometown or office city.

cityTier.description: System-derived from cityName. Metro/Tier1/Tier2/Tier3 classification for cost-of-living and HRA calculations.

options.label: Metro
options.infotip: Mumbai, Delhi-NCR, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune.

options.label: Tier 1
options.infotip: Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Lucknow, Chandigarh, Kochi, Indore, etc.

options.label: Tier 2
options.infotip: Mysore, Bhopal, Dehradun, Ranchi, Guwahati, etc.

hasDependentParents.infotip: Parents or in-laws you contribute to for living or medical expenses.

hasOtherDependents.description: Boolean. Dependents beyond spouse, minor children, parents.

employmentCategory.description: Primary work category. Gates salariedType, selfEmployedType, notEarningType.

salariedType.description: Employer type within salaried category. Gated: employmentCategory == SALARIED.

options.label: Government
options.infotip: High job security, NPS/defined pension, GPF.

options.label: PSU / Public Sector
options.infotip: Near-government stability, EPF + gratuity + group insurance.

options.label: Large Private Company
options.infotip: 5000+ employees. EPF, gratuity, group health insurance.

options.label: Mid / Small Private Company
options.infotip: EPF likely; group insurance possible but not guaranteed.

options.label: Startup
options.infotip: ESOP-heavy comp, minimal benefits.

options.label: Established Business / Practice
options.infotip: 3+ years steady operation.

options.label: New Business (< 3 years)
options.infotip: Under 3 years or pre-revenue.

options.label: Freelancer / Consultant
options.infotip: Serving multiple clients. Project-based fees.

options.label: Gig / Platform Worker
options.infotip: Uber, Swiggy, Urban Company, etc.

options.label: Contract / Commission / Seasonal
options.infotip: Income from fixed-term contracts, commissions, or seasonal activity.

options.label: Retired
options.infotip: Enter pension amount in Monthly Income.

options.label: Homemaker
options.infotip: Enter any rental or investment income in Monthly Income.

options.label: Student
options.infotip: Enter any stipend or part-time income in Monthly Income.

employerStabilityTier.description: Income source stability. Suggested from employment fields; user can confirm or adjust. Gated: SALARIED or SELF_EMPLOYED. Affects emergency fund multiplier.
employerStabilityTier.infotip: We've suggested based on your work type — adjust if it doesn't feel right.

options.label: Very Stable
options.infotip: E.g., government, large PSUs, top-tier MNCs.

options.label: Stable
options.infotip: E.g., profitable large private companies.

options.label: Moderate
options.infotip: E.g., mid-stage startups, cyclical industry.

options.label: Volatile
options.infotip: E.g., early startups, gig work, contract roles.

derivation.logic: employmentCategory == 'SALARIED' ? (salariedType == 'GOVT' ? 'VERY_STABLE' : salariedType == 'PSU' ? 'VERY_STABLE' : salariedType == 'LARGE_PRIVATE' ? 'STABLE' : salariedType == 'MID_SMALL_PRIVATE' ? 'MODERATE' : salariedType == 'STARTUP' ? 'VOLATILE' : 'MODERATE') : employmentCategory == 'SELF_EMPLOYED' ? (selfEmployedType == 'BUSINESS_ESTABLISHED' ? 'MODERATE' : selfEmployedType == 'BUSINESS_NEW' ? 'VOLATILE' : selfEmployedType == 'FREELANCER' ? 'MODERATE' : selfEmployedType == 'GIG_PLATFORM' ? 'VOLATILE' : selfEmployedType == 'CONTRACT' ? 'VOLATILE' : 'MODERATE') : 'NOT_APPLICABLE'

monthlyNetIncome.description: Monthly post-tax take-home. Includes salary, pension, drawings, rental income. Excludes spouse income, reimbursements, one-off bonuses.
monthlyNetIncome.infotip: Amount credited to your bank after tax and deductions. For variable income, use 6–12 month average.

incomePattern.description: Income amount predictability month-to-month. Not income source.

options.label: Fixed Monthly
options.infotip: Under 10% variation month-to-month.

options.label: Variable Monthly
options.infotip: 20%+ swings month-to-month.

options.label: Seasonal
options.infotip: Lean or zero months in between.

options.label: Project Based
options.infotip: Multi-month gaps between payments.

options.label: Mixed
options.infotip: Stable base plus significant variable component.

annualGrossIncome.description: Annual pre-deduction income (Form 16 / ITR). Includes salary, bonuses, employer PF, rental, capital gains.
annualGrossIncome.infotip: The figure on your Form 16 or ITR — before any deductions.

dependencyStatus.description: User's financial self-sufficiency. Dependency ON others, not others on user.
dependencyStatus.infotip: About whether you depend on others — not about who depends on you.

options.label: Fully Dependent
options.infotip: All expenses covered by someone else.

options.label: Partially Dependent
options.infotip: Others cover 30%+ of living expenses.

options.label: Financially Independent
options.infotip: May also support others.

primaryEarner.description: Household's main breadwinner. Affects life insurance need and emergency fund sizing.
primaryEarner.infotip: In dual-income homes, the earner whose loss causes greater disruption.

incomeTaxRegime.description: Current FY Indian income tax regime. Gates section80cUtilized.

options.label: Old Regime
options.infotip: Allows 80C, 80D, HRA, LTA, home loan interest, NPS deductions.

options.label: New Regime
options.infotip: Lower rates but almost no deductions.

options.label: Not Sure
options.infotip: Not yet decided.

section80cUtilized.description: Gated: OLD_REGIME only. Max ₹1.5L. Includes EPF (employee), PPF, ELSS, LIC, NSC, tuition, home loan principal.
section80cUtilized.infotip: Includes EPF (your share), PPF, ELSS, LIC premiums, NSC, tuition fees, home loan principal.

residenceStatus.infotip: Where you currently live — not investment property.

options.label: Owned With Loan
options.infotip: EMI goes in Total EMIs.

options.label: Owned Outright
options.infotip: Include maintenance and property tax in Housing Expenses.

options.label: Company Provided
options.infotip: Enter only what you pay out of pocket in Housing Expenses.

options.label: Living With Family
options.infotip: Household contributions (rent share, maintenance) go in Housing Expenses.

options.label: Other
options.infotip: Co-living, hostel, PG. Enter housing cost in Housing Expenses.

housingExpenses.description: Monthly housing cash outflows. Gated: residenceStatus IN [RENTED, COMPANY_PROVIDED, OTHER, OWNED_OUTRIGHT, LIVING_WITH_FAMILY]. Includes rent or occupancy fee, society maintenance, RWA charges, property tax (monthly equivalent). Excludes home loan EMI (captured in Total Monthly EMI) and utility bills.
housingExpenses.infotip: Housing expenses including maintenance, and property tax (÷12). Do NOT include home loan EMI.

monthlyNonDiscretionaryExpenses.description: Essential expense floor — minimum spend in a crisis. Excludes rent, EMIs, SIPs, insurance premiums, discretionary.
monthlyNonDiscretionaryExpenses.infotip: Groceries, utilities, commuting, school fees, medicines. Excludes rent, EMIs, SIPs, insurance premiums, and discretionary spending.

monthlyInsurancePremiums.description: All personal/family insurance premiums monthly. Excludes vehicle/property and employer-paid.
monthlyInsurancePremiums.infotip: Health, term life, accident, critical illness. Divide annual/quarterly by 12 or 3.

totalMonthlyEmi.description: All active loan EMIs combined. Excludes rent, SIPs, insurance premiums.
totalMonthlyEmi.infotip: Home, car, personal, education, gold loans + credit card EMI conversions. Not bills paid in full.

totalOutstandingDebt.description: Total principal owed across all loans and revolving credit.
totalOutstandingDebt.infotip: All loans plus revolving credit card balances. Enter 0 if debt-free.

options.label: Current User
options.infotip: Any usage in last 12 months counts.

options.label: Former User
options.infotip: Most insurers need 12–36 months tobacco-free for non-smoker rates.

preExistingConditions.description: Self-reported medical conditions. Multi-select — combinations allowed.
preExistingConditions.infotip: Select all that apply. Self-reported — not a diagnosis.

options.label: Minor / Managed Condition
options.infotip: E.g., mild BP, stable thyroid, mild allergies.

options.label: Chronic Condition
options.infotip: E.g., diabetes, BP, asthma, PCOD.

options.label: Critical Illness History
options.infotip: E.g., cancer, heart attack, stroke, organ transplant.

options.label: Prefer Not To Say
options.infotip: Conservative defaults applied.

healthInsuranceCoverAmount.description: Total health sum insured across all active policies. Excludes life and accident cover.
healthInsuranceCoverAmount.infotip: Add all policies. On a floater? Enter full floater amount. Enter 0 if uninsured.

healthInsuranceSource.description: Primary health cover source. Portability risk factor.
healthInsuranceSource.infotip: If multiple sources, select the highest sum insured.

options.label: Employer Group
options.infotip: Tied to your job — lost on resignation, layoff, or retirement.

options.label: Retail Individual
options.infotip: Portable — continues regardless of employment.

options.label: Retail Family Floater
options.infotip: Shared sum insured across family. Portable.

options.label: Government Scheme
options.infotip: Ayushman Bharat, CGHS, ESI, ECHS.

termLifeCoverAmount.description: Total term life death benefit. Pure protection. Excludes endowment, ULIP, accident cover.
termLifeCoverAmount.infotip: All term life policies combined. Enter 0 if none.

options.label: Conservative
options.infotip: Would likely redeem if portfolio drops 10%.

options.label: Moderate
options.infotip: Can tolerate a 15–20% portfolio drop.

options.label: Aggressive
options.infotip: Comfortable with 30%+ drops. Long-term mindset.

options.label: Not Sure
options.infotip: Moderate default applied; refined over time.

financialLiteracyLevel.description: Financial concept familiarity. Controls communication depth, not advice quality.
financialLiteracyLevel.infotip: Doesn't affect advice quality — only how we communicate.

options.label: Level 1
options.infotip: Unfamiliar with SIPs, NAV, CAGR.

options.label: Level 2
options.infotip: Knows FDs, PPF, MF/SIP basics.

options.label: Level 3
options.infotip: Comfortable with fund categories, tax instruments.

options.label: Level 4
options.infotip: Portfolio theory, tax optimisation, financial modelling.

options.label: Not Sure
options.infotip: We start at Level 2 and adjust.

targetRetirementAge.description: Planned age to stop active income. Sets accumulation horizon.
targetRetirementAge.infotip: For gradual wind-down, enter the age when income drops significantly.

decisionMakingStyle.description: How user makes major financial decisions. Affects recommendation framing.

options.label: Delegator
options.infotip: Consults CA, planner, or parent before acting.

monthlySipCommitment.description: Total recurring investment commitment monthly. MF SIPs, RDs, PPF/NPS/SSY. Excludes lump-sum and EMIs.
monthlySipCommitment.infotip: LIC endowment/ULIP: include here if primarily investment, in insurance premiums if primarily cover.

totalLiquidSavings.description: Cash accessible within 1–3 days. Savings accounts, liquid MFs, breakable FDs. Excludes equity, long-term FDs, EPF, PPF, NPS, gold.
totalLiquidSavings.infotip: E.g., savings/current account balance, liquid or overnight MFs, FDs breakable without penalty. Not equity, EPF, PPF, NPS, or gold.

totalEquityInvestments.description: Current market value of equity and market-linked investments. Stocks, equity MFs, ELSS, ETFs, ULIPs. Excludes liquid, debt, FDs, EPF, PPF, real estate, gold.

totalFixedIncome.description: Redeemable fixed-income (accessible < 30 days). FDs, RDs, NSC, debt MFs, bonds, SGBs. Excludes EPF, NPS I, PPF, SSY, equity, liquid.
totalFixedIncome.infotip: E.g., FDs, RDs, NSC, debt mutual funds, bonds, SGBs. Not EPF, PPF, NPS, or equity.

totalRetirementCorpus.description: Retirement-locked instruments. EPF, VPF, NPS I, PPF, SSY, superannuation, gratuity. Not available for emergencies.
totalRetirementCorpus.infotip: E.g., EPF, VPF, PPF, NPS Tier I, Sukanya Samriddhi, gratuity. NPS Tier II goes in Fixed Income.
